matching._fuzzy_comment: Order-preserving phonetic LCS matcher. Used as a FALLBACK only when exact shingle-hash confidence is below threshold (STT word errors break exact shingles). min_lcs_ratio = min (LCS length / query tokens) to accept a match; min_query_tokens guards against trusting very short queries; weight scales the fuzzy confidence; min_margin requires the top candidate to beat the runner-up by this gap (LCS is biased toward longer/common-word references, so ambiguous near-ties are rejected and the safer exact verdict is kept).

_dvd_comment: identify_dvd_episodes.py (batch DVD-rip identification) transcribes a few short audio samples from each unknown file with STT and matches the dialogue against the subtitle-built database using the 'matching' + 'fuzzy' settings above. Exact phonetic-shingle matching runs first; the order-preserving fuzzy matcher is the fallback when STT word errors break exact shingles.
